source_text: Omnis masculus de sacerdotali genere edet. Masculus — sensus fortis; non dissolutus affectus. Sancta sanctis.
pass_a_gloss: Every male from priestly race will-eat. Male — sense strong; not dissolute affection. Holy-things to-holy-ones.
pass_b_english: [[Every male among the priests may eat it >> Bible:Leviticus 6:29]]. “Male” means a strong sense, not a slack affection. Holy things for the holy.
